title: Does self-distillation improve reasoning?
abstract: arXiv:2610.18613v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-distillation is an emerging approach that trains a model to imitate its own predictions when conditioned on privileged information, such as correct answers or environmental feedback. Recent methods have reported better sample efficiency and generalization than reinforcement learning (RL), but it remains unclear whether these gains extend beyond in-distribution evaluations and whether they stem from privileged distillation. In this paper, we revisit two representative methods, Self-Distillation Policy Optimization (SDPO) and On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), across code, science, tool use, and math reasoning tasks. We find that their reported gains do not consistently generalize to unseen problems and are largely explained by overfitting or transferring existing reasoning behavior, rather than effectively using privileged information. translated_title: 自蒸馏能提升推理能力吗？
translated_abstract: 自蒸馏（Self-distillation）是一种新兴方法，它训练模型在给定特权信息（如正确答案或环境反馈）的条件下模仿自身的预测。近期的方法报告了比强化学习（RL）更好的样本效率和泛化能力，但这些收益是否能够扩展到分布内评估之外，以及是否源于特权蒸馏，仍不清楚。在本文中，我们在代码、科学、工具使用和数学推理等任务上重新审视了两种代表性方法——自蒸馏策略优化（SDPO）和在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）。我们发现，它们所报告的收益并不能一致地泛化到未见过的测试问题上，且这些收益在很大程度上可以由过拟合或对已有推理行为的迁移来解释，而非有效利用了特权信息。此外，自蒸馏梯度与直接优化的策略梯度仅呈现微弱的一致性。
tldr: 该研究发现，SDPO和OPSD等自蒸馏方法的收益并不能稳定泛化到未见过的测试问题上，其提升主要源于过拟合或迁移已有推理行为，而非有效利用特权信息。
